name: technitium-mcp
description: MCP server for Technitium DNS Server management and diagnostics
long_description: Security-hardened MCP server exposing 39 DNS management tools against a Technitium DNS Server instance. Supports zone and record management, blocking lists, cache control, DNSSEC inspection, query logs, and DNS app installation. Features rate limiting, audit logging, read-only mode, and sensitive-value redaction.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: URL of your Technitium DNS server (e.g. https://192.168.1.100:53443)

api_token.title: API Token
api_token.description: API token for authentication — preferred over password.

password.title: Admin Password
password.description: Admin password — only used if no API token is provided.

readonly.title: Read-Only Mode
readonly.description: When enabled, exposes only the 18 read-only query tools and hides all write operations

allow_http.title: Allow HTTP
allow_http.description: Allow insecure HTTP connections. Only enable this if your Technitium server is on a trusted local network with no HTTPS configured.
